findings: The model correctly represented e003 as both user preference and counterpressure and e004 as user uncertainty.
The v2.2 flattening of user-owned attitudes into reported_without_endorsement did not repeat.

The record included contextual e001 but did not turn it into a stance component; e002 was omitted as a component, so the external offer/user-attitude contrast is semantically adequate but not target-exact.
The bounded pilot, conditional approval, and threshold action remain one coherent thread.
The model again included the explicitly unresolved e036 in current, despite the v2.3 role-boundary contract telling it not to do so.
The e035 statement 'I will set' was labeled decision rather than the source-first commitment target; this is not gross force inflation but is not target-exact.
Assistant-authored persistence and irreversibility meanings survive without being rewritten as user adoption.
The component labels reported_without_endorsement for e039/e040 treat assistant assertions as unendorsed reports, contrary to the contract's source-speaker-relative interpretation.

relationship_review.finding: The relationship correctly makes meaningful exit conditional on persistent learning, but it compresses the broader protected effects on engineering choices, expectations, trust, and public identity.

decision.next_architectural_question: Can qualification and current interpretations be coordinated probabilistically, or reconciled in one bounded semantic task, without deterministic keyword gates, hard alias subtraction, semantic scoring, or an uncontrolled increase in calls?

unknowns: It is unknown whether cross-role context would remove duplication or merely bias the later reader toward the earlier output.
Some aliases can legitimately contain both an adopted condition and an unresolved matter, so hard evidence-ID exclusivity would be brittle.
A reconciliation task could improve role allocation but may add latency, cost, and another probabilistic failure surface.
No downstream challenge-quality or product-utility claim is authorized.
